hypothesis: Caching the deterministic card embedding vectors between inference decisions will reduce repeated PyTorch embedding and semantic-encoder work without changing the checkpoint, training path, or observable game trajectory.
novelty: The repository history contains runtime measurements embedded in quality experiments but no dedicated performance-family experiment. This pass isolates an inference-only cache with the same v002 checkpoint and fixed game workload.

selected_idea.idea: Reuse static scorer card embeddings across NeuralPlayer evaluation decisions.
selected_idea.reason: The cProfile baseline identified repeated _embedding_lookup/_card_embeddings work as a hot path; the vectors depend only on frozen evaluation weights and card definitions.

performance.gate: accepted: median elapsed time improved by 11.76%, exceeding the 2% performance threshold

analysis.change: Added an inference-only per-scorer cache in shards_ai/ai/neural_model.py. Missing card vectors are computed once and reused; training mode and gradient-enabled execution use the original uncached path.
analysis.attribution: The baseline profile put 0.473 seconds in _embedding_lookup and 0.383 seconds in _card_embeddings over five representative games, while NeuralPlayer scoring dominated the runtime. The candidate keeps the same checkpoint, seeds, players, action limit, thread count and action/decision counts, so the elapsed reduction is attributable to avoiding repeated static embedding computation.

future_ideas: Profile the remaining encode_observation, pooling and action-representation costs before another runtime change.
Measure actual reuse before considering a bounded cache for immutable action representations.
Reject any pooling shortcut that changes trajectories or any cache that is not safely invalidated during training.

commands.benchmark: PYTHONPATH=. poetry run python benchmarks/benchmark_neural_players.py --checkpoint configs/neural_profiles/v002.pt --opponent neural --opponent-checkpoint configs/neural_profiles/v002.pt --games 50 --seed 0 --torch-threads 1 --output <result.json>
commands.profile: PYTHONPATH=. poetry run python -m cProfile -s cumulative -o /tmp/shards-exp-performance/baseline.prof benchmarks/benchmark_neural_players.py --checkpoint configs/neural_profiles/v002.pt --opponent neural --opponent-checkpoint configs/neural_profiles/v002.pt --games 5 --seed 0 --torch-threads 1
